Modern.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the Bayeux Tapestry — the c.1070 embroidered 70-metre narrative cloth depicting the Norman conquest of England, the most famous surviving piece of medieval embroidery. Bayeux is a French place name, not a live marque trademark; 'Studio' frames the brand as a modern atelier in the narrative-stitch register.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern embroidery is a small editorial category — small studios making commissioned narrative pieces, monograms, and small editions. The opening is for a studio that names the narrative-stitch lineage.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Fine Cell Work (finecellwork.co.uk) plays the editorial peer. Royal School of Needlework (royal-needlework.org.uk) holds the heritage middle. Hand & Lock (handembroidery.com) is the commissions reference. We sit as a narrative-stitch modern studio.
Modern.positioningStatement: Bayeux Studio is a modern embroidery studio making narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.

targetAudience.primary: Commissioning buyers 35-65 who want a narrative piece for a wall or a wedding.
behaviors: Care about the lineage and the stitch
Wait six to twenty-four months on a piece

dos: Name the stitch and the thread
Show the back of the work
donts: Photograph the embroiderer's hands at work

Modern.logoDirection: Wordmark: BAYEUX STUDIO set in a confident modern grotesk, two words on one line. Small mark: a single laid-stitch silhouette used on the commission card.

typography.primary: Söhne for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Söhne Mono for stitch and thread lists
typography.rationale: A modern grotesk plus its mono — the commission-card register.

Modern.brandDescription: Bayeux Studio is a modern embroidery studio making narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.
Modern.scope: Bayeux Studio works across the embroidery & needlework category with a single editorial register.
Modern.mission: Bayeux Studio is a modern embroidery studio making narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.
Modern.vision: Bayeux Studio held in its register, indefinitely.

Luxury.tagline: White on white, by the inch.
Luxury.brandNameRationale: Anchor: whitework — the family of white-on-white embroidery traditions including Mountmellick (Ireland, 1825), Ayrshire (Scotland, 1820s), Hardanger (Norway, 17th c.), and Schwalm (Germany). 'Atelier' frames the brand as a heritage luxury house in the whitework lineage. No live marque trademark on the technique name.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury embroidery is a narrow editorial category — small houses making heirloom commissions, christening pieces, and trousseau linens. The opening is for a whitework-anchored atelier.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Hand & Lock (handembroidery.com) plays the heritage London peer. Royal School of Needlework (royal-needlework.org.uk) holds the master-craft middle. Lesage (lesage-paris.com) is the couture-embroidery reference. We sit as a whitework-anchored heritage atelier.
Luxury.positioningStatement: Whitework Atelier is a heritage embroidery house making heirloom whitework — christening robes, trousseau linens, and commissioned panels.

targetAudience.primary: Heirloom buyers and family commissioners across generations.
behaviors: Wait twelve to twenty-four months on a piece

dos: Name the whitework tradition (Mountmellick, Ayrshire, Hardanger, Schwalm)
Print the commission card with the work

Luxury.logoDirection: Wordmark: WHITEWORK ATELIER set in a classical book serif, three lines centered. Small mark: an embossed laid-and-couched motif used as the seal.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and signage
typography.secondary: Garamond Premier Pro for body and the commission card
typography.rationale: A classical serif plus a reading serif — the heritage-atelier register.

Luxury.brandDescription: Whitework Atelier is a heritage embroidery house making heirloom whitework — christening robes, trousseau linens, and commissioned panels.
Luxury.scope: Whitework Atelier works across the embroidery & needlework category with a single editorial register.
Luxury.mission: Whitework Atelier is a heritage embroidery house making heirloom whitework — christening robes, trousseau linens, and commissioned panels.
Luxury.vision: Whitework Atelier held in its register, indefinitely.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the sampler — the practice cloth stitched by girls from the 17th to 19th centuries to record alphabets, motifs, and the year of completion. One word, one trade noun. The brand is named after the form that taught the form.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal embroidery brands serve the design-literate buyer who wants one sampler — one cloth, one alphabet, one year.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Most embroidery brands publish a long catalog of designs. The minimal end is largely empty. Fine Cell Work (finecellwork.co.uk) is the closest editorial reference. We sit as the single-form minimal option.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Sampler is a minimal embroidery brand making one sampler — alphabet, motif, and year — to commission.

targetAudience.primary: Design-conscious commissioners 28-50 who want one cloth done well.
behaviors: Care about the alphabet and the year

Minimal.logoDirection: Wordmark: SAMPLER set very large in a clean modern sans, one word. No symbol.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for the year and the alphabet
typography.rationale: Clean Diatype with its mono — the single-cloth register.

Minimal.brandDescription: Sampler is a minimal embroidery brand making one sampler — alphabet, motif, and year — to commission.
Minimal.scope: Sampler works across the embroidery & needlework category with a single editorial register.
Minimal.mission: Sampler is a minimal embroidery brand making one sampler — alphabet, motif, and year — to commission.
Minimal.vision: Sampler held in its register, indefinitely.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Anchor: Suzhou silk embroidery (Su xiu) — one of the four great traditions of Chinese embroidery, dating to over 4,000 years ago, recognised by China's national list of intangible cultural heritage. 'Silk Holdings' frames the brand as a B2B silk-and-embroidery supply operator with a heritage anchor. Suzhou is geographic; no live marque trademark in this register.
Corporate.industrySummary: Silk-embroidery supply is a small institutional category serving fashion houses, costume departments, and interior-design clients. The opening is for a heritage-named multi-line operator.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Hangzhou Wensli Group (wensli.com) plays the silk-supply reference. Suzhou Embroidery Research Institute (suzhouembroidery.cn) holds the heritage institute middle. Maison Lesage (lesage-paris.com) is the couture-embroidery peer. We sit as a heritage-named supply holdings company.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Suzhou Silk Holdings is a silk-embroidery supply operator serving fashion houses, costume departments, and interior-design clients with documented heritage provenance.

targetAudience.primary: Fashion house ateliers, costume-department buyers, and interior-design procurement officers.
behaviors: Specify silk grade and embroidery technique
Renew on three- to five-year terms

dos: Lead with silk grade and embroidery lineage
Refer to client houses by name in trade material
donts: No social media at the parent level

Corporate.logoDirection: Wordmark: SUZHOU SILK HOLDINGS set in an institutional serif, three lines. A small mark — a stylised silk-worm cocoon — used on contracts.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and headlines
typography.rationale: A reading serif plus a clean grotesk — the heritage supply register.

Corporate.brandDescription: Suzhou Silk Holdings is a silk-embroidery supply operator serving fashion houses, costume departments, and interior-design clients with documented heritage provenance.
Corporate.scope: Suzhou Silk Holdings works across the embroidery & needlework category with a single editorial register.
Corporate.mission: Suzhou Silk Holdings is a silk-embroidery supply operator serving fashion houses, costume departments, and interior-design clients with documented heritage provenance.
Corporate.vision: Suzhou Silk Holdings held in its register, indefinitely.

Creative.tagline: A thousand years, one stitch at a time.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the c.1070 date of the Bayeux Tapestry — the editorial frame is the year as the brand. 'Threads' frames the brand as a creative narrative-stitch studio in the long-record register. Year-as-brand is editorial and trademark-clear.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative embroidery brands play on a single date, place, or process as the editorial frame. The year 1070 as a brand frame is rich and under-used.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Fine Cell Work (finecellwork.co.uk) plays the editorial peer. Hand & Lock (handembroidery.com) holds the commissions middle. Royal School of Needlework (royal-needlework.org.uk) is the heritage reference. We sit as a year-anchored creative studio in the narrative-stitch register.
Creative.positioningStatement: 1070 Threads is a creative embroidery brand built on the Bayeux Tapestry's date — narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.

targetAudience.primary: Commissioning buyers 35-60 who want a narrative piece with a story.
behaviors: Care about the year on the cloth

dos: Print the year on every commission card
Name the stitch and the lineage
Show the back of the work

Creative.logoDirection: Wordmark: 1070 THREADS set in a warm display serif, two lines centered. Small mark: a single laid-and-couched motif used on commission cards.

typography.primary: GT Sectra for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Söhne for body and commission cards
typography.rationale: A warm display serif plus a clean grotesk — the editorial narrative-stitch register.

Creative.brandDescription: 1070 Threads is a creative embroidery brand built on the Bayeux Tapestry's date — narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.
Creative.scope: 1070 Threads works across the embroidery & needlework category with a single editorial register.
Creative.mission: 1070 Threads is a creative embroidery brand built on the Bayeux Tapestry's date — narrative-stitch commissions in the long-record register.
